Transaction and record cache administration, publish, cancel, reset, clear, and verify operations.

# Purpose
This file implements administrative operations for `fd_progcache`, which manages program cache state on top of a `fd_funk` instance. It includes functions to estimate record capacity with [`fd_progcache_est_rec_max`](<#fd_progcache_est_rec_max>), attach and detach the admin object with [`fd_progcache_admin_join`](<#fd_progcache_admin_join>) and [`fd_progcache_admin_leave`](<#fd_progcache_admin_leave>), and verify the underlying state with [`fd_progcache_verify`](<#fd_progcache_verify>). The code works with the shared `funk` object, its transaction pool, record pool, and hash maps, and it uses logging and fatal checks to stop on invalid state.

The main body of the file handles transaction and record lifecycle control. It provides functions to cancel a transaction tree, publish transaction records into the root state, advance the root transaction, reset all transaction record links, clear all transactions, and remove all records from the record map. These operations update linked lists, hash maps, transaction states, and shared-memory pointers in a fixed order so the cache state stays consistent during publish, cancel, reset, and clear operations.
